name: assembly
description: flacmn deck pro, round 8 as built: folded shell and flat back plate (sheet STEPs), DAC Pro, both PEC11R-4215F encoders (shafts cut to 10 mm), and the Raspberry Pi 5 model standing in for the Pi 4 (same 85 x 56 board, holes and port edges; USB/Ethernet stack order differs). Not modelled yet: the 5in DSI screen, knob caps, standoffs, screws.
_frames: World: x right, y back from the front face, z up. Sheet parts are stood up (sheet (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y)): xform rows are the images of the part's x, y, z axes, then the translation. Pi and DAC turned 180 deg about z (USB/Ethernet to -x, sockets to the back). Encoders: shaft (+z) to -y, body top against the front face's inner side (y = t).

expected._comment: Envelope: the shell's 241 x 88.5 in x and z; in y from the cut encoder shaft tips to the back plate's outer face 100.5. Shaft tip: body top at y = 1, shaft cut to 10 above the body top -> y = -9, flush with the 8 mm caps' faces (1 mm off the front face + 8).
allowed_interference: GPIO header in the DAC Pro's socket
